meta.name: Phantasm III Lord Of The Dead
meta.description: The Tall Man, that imposing menace from Morningside Mortuary, is back and once again haunting the thoughts of the now-adult Mike and his friend, ex-Ice Cream vendor Reggie. The two continue their hunt for the mysterious figure and in his path of destruction encounter a variety of dangerous situations, friends and enemies.
meta.slogan: If You Don't Get It This Time, He'll Have To Drill It Into Your Head!
